bullets: Added Nemotron 3.5 Lightning as the first option in the free model picker unlimited section.
Updated the free model picker to highlight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as the recommended choice in the Optimized section.
Ended the first-month introductory discount for paid subscriptions on October 24, 2026.
Added Solar Pro 4 and Solar Mini 4 to the list of models that receive turn-ending execution reminders.
Changed the order of the free model picker to place the unlimited section last for most users.
Fixed a security issue where sensitive environment files were included in AI code search results.
Improved error messages when the AI runs out of memory to suggest specific fixes for BYOK versus hosted models.
Updated the terminal tool on Linux and remote connections to honestly report when a copy to clipboard may have failed.
Added higher reasoning effort options for users who connect their own ChatGPT accounts to the service.
Fixed a bug where the assistant could get stuck in a loop when repeatedly rejecting the same file edit in review mode.
Prevented the terminal app from accidentally deleting your chat history if your computer loses power during a save.
Fixed a bug where the terminal app could briefly lose your login status when other programs checked your session.
Fixed an error message that incorrectly told you to add a key when the external AI provider was simply too busy.
Corrected the display of provider errors so the app no longer blames your internet connection for upstream outages.
Allowed the coding assistant to leave out its standard credit lines in save points when you explicitly request it.
Enabled parallel sessions for GPT-6 Luna, MiMo 2.6 Pro, and DeepSeek Flash fast mode to reduce waiting time.
Improved the Linux terminal app to correctly read your clipboard on modern Wayland window manager systems.
Increased the minimum daily budget for buying ad spaces from $25 to $50.
Updated the terminal app to wait briefly before reporting an ad click to ensure the view is registered first.
Updated the terminal app to use server-built task descriptions for sponsored runs instead of generating them locally.
Stopped the terminal app from accepting free-text tasks for sponsored runs to ensure instructions are consistent.
Added a new instruction in the conversation history for Solar Pro 4 and Solar Mini 4 to ensure they perform tasks.
Updated the terminal app to save login details using a safer method that prevents other programs from seeing a broken file.
